title: Asymptote Labs Lands $5.5 Million Seed for AI Agent Runtime Security
description: Asymptote Labs has raised $5.5 million in seed funding to develop Beacon, an AI agent runtime security platform. Beacon is an open source telemetry layer that standardizes activity from multiple AI agent harnesses and normalizes telemetry into a unified data model. The commercial platform enforces policy guardrails in real time to prevent unsafe or risky AI agent behavior. This initiative addresses the lack of infrastructure for monitoring and controlling autonomous AI agents accessing sensitive corporate data.
aiSummary: Asymptote Labs is commercializing Beacon, an AI agent runtime security platform designed to provide visibility and control over autonomous AI agents operating within enterprise environments. Beacon collects telemetry from over 20 different AI agent harnesses, normalizing this data into a unified model based on the OpenTelemetry framework. The platform intercepts live AI agent activity to enforce policy guardrails at both prompt and execution levels, steering agents away from unsafe behavior and blocking risky actions before they occur. This approach aims to fill the monitoring blind spots faced by security teams as AI agents become a new operational layer in organizations.
aiImpact: The platform aims to mitigate risks associated with autonomous AI agents accessing sensitive corporate data by providing real-time monitoring and control. While no specific vulnerabilities or exploits are described, the technology addresses potential security gaps in AI agent runtime behavior, reducing the likelihood of unsafe or unauthorized actions by these agents.
